## Level Progression

| Class Level | Total Level | Date | New Features | Spell Slots |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wizard 1 | 1 | — | Spellcasting (INT), Arcane Recovery, Illusionist subclass | 1st ×2 |
| Wizard 2 | 2 | — | Spellbook growth (+2), Improved Minor Illusion | 1st ×3 |
| Wizard 3 | 3 | — | 2nd-level slots | 1st ×4 · 2nd ×2 |
| **Wizard 4** | **4** | **2026-05-22** | **War Caster feat** · Prepared spells → 7 | **1st ×4 · 2nd ×3** |
| **Ranger 1** ◄ | **5** | **2026-05-22** | **Spellcasting (WIS), Favored Enemy, Weapon Mastery · Medium armor + Shields + Martial weapons** | **shared pool** |
| Wizard 5 | 6 | | 3rd-level slots | 1st×4 · 2nd×3 · 3rd×2 |
| Ranger 2 | 7 | | Fighting Style | + |
| Ranger 3 | 8 | | **Ranger Conclave (subclass)** *(choose at this level)* | + |
| Wizard 6 | 9 | | Malleable Illusions (Illusionist subclass) | … |
| Wizard 7 | 9 | | ASI or Feat | … |
| Wizard 8 | 10 | | | … |

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Multiclass spell slots (D&D 2024):** Wizard 4 (full caster = 4) + Ranger 1 (half caster = 0) = **level 4** on the multiclass table → 1st ×4 · 2nd ×3. Slots are shared; Wizard spells use INT, Ranger spells use WIS.
:::

## Ranger 1 Features (D&D 2024)

| Feature | Details |
|---|---|
| **Spellcasting** | WIS-based · DC 11 · Attack +3 · 1 prepared Ranger spell |
| **Favored Enemy** | **Hobgoblin** — Hunter's Mark always prepared; 1/day no slot cost |
| **Weapon Mastery** | Light Crossbow (**Slow** — target speed −10 ft) · Warhammer (**Push** — push 10 ft on hit) |
| **Armor** | Light, Medium, Shields now available |
| **Weapons** | Simple + Martial weapons |
| **Saving Throws** | STR, DEX added |
| **Skills (×3)** | Stealth, Perception *(+1 TBD — Investigation already a Wizard proficiency; swap for Athletics, Insight, Nature, Survival, or Animal Handling)* |
| **Subclass** | *(TBD at Ranger 3: Hunter, Beast Master, Gloom Stalker, Fey Wanderer, Swarmkeeper)* |
